verification.source: Read live over SSH (scontrol, sinfo, lscpu, nvidia-smi, module avail) and test jobs on 2026-11-27

hardware.cpu: Arm Neoverse-V2, 1 socket x 72 cores x 1 thread

scheduler.controller: prado (a separate host; naur is a compute node that also accepts logins)
scheduler.accounting_note: slurm.conf names slurmdbd, but the database refuses connections, so sacct and sacctmgr fail. Treat the machine as having no accounting.
scheduler.gpu_request: --gres=gpu:1 (or --gpus=1); gpu:2 or more is refused at submit
scheduler.memory_request: unsupported — the node is registered with RealMemory=1 MiB, so any real --mem value is refused at submit; memory is not allocated or limited per job
scheduler.select: cons_tres, CR_CORE (cores are allocated per job; memory is not)
scheduler.history: No sacct. A finished job stays visible to scontrol for about five minutes (MinJobAge=300).
scheduler.gpu_isolation: enforced — cgroup ConstrainDevices=yes, so a job without a GPU request cannot see the GPU
scheduler.cpu_isolation: enforced — task/cgroup + task/affinity confine a job to its allocated cores

other_partitions_in_same_slurm: prado, shannon and backus are separate hosts in the same Slurm cluster. They are not part of this facility; jobs submitted here must use the naur partition.

storage.home: /data1/<group>/<lab>/<user>, a symlink into /work1 (local NVMe on naur, ~1.8 TB, no quota)
storage.node_local_scratch: home is itself local to naur; there is no separate shared or parallel filesystem

modules.system: environment-modules (Tcl); /opt/modulefiles and /opt/nvidia/hpc_sdk/modulefiles are on the default MODULEPATH
modules.nvhpc: nvhpc/26.9, nvhpc-nompi/26.9, nvhpc-hpcx/26.9, nvhpc-hpcx-cuda13/26.9, nvhpc-hpcx-cuda13-openmpi4/26.9, nvhpc-hpcx-cuda13-openmpi5/26.9, nvhpc-byo-compiler/26.9

software.cuda: 13.2 at /usr/local/cuda (also 13.1); the HPC SDK bundles its own CUDA 13.3. nvcc is not on PATH until a module is loaded.
software.compilers: system GCC/gfortran 13.3; nvc/nvc++/nvfortran from the nvhpc modules
software.mpi: no system MPI; mpirun/mpicc come from the nvhpc modules. srun supports pmi2 and pmix (v5).
software.containers: no Singularity/Apptainer; a docker binary exists but ordinary users cannot reach its daemon
